description: This Java source file defines the 'AttributeDeleted' event class which models an event emitted after an attribute of a 'Thing' is deleted within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes constructors, JSON serialization/deserialization, and methods to access event details.

classes.name: AttributeDeleted
classes.description: Final class representing an event signaling that a Thing's attribute was deleted within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing instances, JSON serialization, and retrieving event details.
